summary: Two real bugs in the cart; the rest looks sound.

findings.title: Discount applied twice when coupon is re-added
findings.situation: A user applies the 10% coupon, then applies it again: the discount becomes 20% because the coupon is not recorded as used.
findings.fix: Ignore a coupon whose code is already in self.coupons, and set the discount from the coupon list instead of adding.

findings.title: Empty cart total divides by zero
findings.situation: average_price() on an empty cart raises ZeroDivisionError.
findings.fix: Return 0.0 when the cart has no items.

checked_ok: Cart.add_item merges quantities for the same sku correctly
